title: P5 generated DWG-origin typed SUN group-63 output and owner closure
scope: Exercise the DWG-origin typed-only SUN adapter path for same-version AC1024 output, with exact group-63 projection, VPORT and VIEWPORT ownership/reference closure, both DXF encodings, strict destination preservation, and corrected retry.
implementation: Allow a same-version AC1021+ DWG-origin typed-only SUN graph while continuing to require exact typed/raw pairing and closed identity edges for the DXF-origin raw replay route.
Write each validated DWG-origin typed SUN exactly once through dxfRW::writeSun; retain raw-object replay for DXF-origin SUN records.
Register canonical SUN/AcDbSun CLASS metadata for typed DWG-origin SUN records and reject conflicting or duplicate class rows.
Validate owner and consumer links for VPORT and VIEWPORT, including remapped output handles and emitted group 330/361 fields.
Keep unrepresentable RGB CMC output fail-closed.

failure_and_retry.firstAttempt: An RGB CMC SUN is refused and a pre-existing destination remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
failure_and_retry.retry: After changing the same adapter data to group-63-faithful ACI, export succeeds; fresh import confirms both owner paths and both typed/raw SUN records.
failure_and_retry.scope: The test exercises the adapter's per-export failure and corrected retry. It does not qualify physical DWG read admission or native renderer behavior.

proven: ASCII and Binary DXF serialize two typed SUN records with matching typed identity and owner parent handles after fresh readback.
Wire-level group 330 owner handles and group 361 references match the remapped VPORT/VIEWPORT and SUN identities.
Group 63 values 42 and 7, and canonical SUN/AcDbSun CLASS instanceCount 2, survive readback.
RGB CMC refusal preserves the destination and corrected ACI retry succeeds on the same adapter.
not_proven: No physical DWG with a fully admitted SUN/VPORT/VIEWPORT graph was read or converted.
No native CAD/rendering consumer or renderer semantics were qualified.
No lossless RGB, color-name, or color-book CMC output route was established; those states remain refused.
No support claim or whole P5 exit gate is promoted by this generated transport test.
planImpact: Remove generated same-version DWG-origin typed-only ACI SUN serializer/owner transport from the open implementation queue. Retain physical-source and native-rendering qualification, remaining rendering profiles, and all unsupported CMC cases as open work.
